questions.question: Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.
questions.evidence: full name means first name, last name; There are at most 3 administrators for each school; SAT Scores are greater or equal to 1500 refers to fld040
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld079, T2.fld080, T2.fld082, T2.fld083, T2.fld085, T2.fld086 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld030 = T2.fld001 ORDER BY T1.fld040 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1, T2.AdmFName2, T2.AdmLName2, T2.AdmFName3, T2.AdmLName3 FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
questions.evidence: Difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment can be computed by fld019 - fld024
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld046, T2.fld065 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld064 = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.fld019 - T1.fld024) > (SELECT AVG(T3.fld019 - T3.fld024) FROM tab01 AS T3 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T4 ON T3.fld001 = T4.fld001 WHERE T4.fld064 = 'Locally funded')
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')

questions.question: Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?
questions.evidence: Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17) can be acquired by fld027 / fld024 * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld046, T1.fld027 * 100 / T1.fld024 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld044 = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.fld074 = 'K-9'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.School, T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.GSserved = 'K-9'

questions.question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
questions.evidence: Total enrollment can be represented by fld019 + fld024
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld001 FROM tab03 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld019 + T2.fld024 > 500
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

questions.question: Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?
questions.evidence: Percent eligible for free meals = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Total (Enrollment (K-12)
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld008 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld030 = T2.fld001 WHERE CAST(T2.fld020 AS REAL) / T2.fld019 > 0.1 AND T1.fld040 > 0
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.`School Name` FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE CAST(T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1 AND T1.NumGE1500 > 0
